description: Player props graded from the official nfl.com player game logs, and the parlay families. No prop or parlay price exists in scope, so these families are graded but cannot be staked.

prop_signal.name: Passing yards: model line against the official game log
prop_signal.rule: For each quarterback game after the third, the model line is the shrunk mean of that quarterback's own earlier games. The side is the one the model prefers. The outcome is the official passing-yard total on nfl.com.
prop_signal.break_even_note: No prop price exists in scope, so there is no break-even rate and no return. The test is against a coin flip.

prop_combination.name: Two-leg player-prop combination across different weeks
prop_combination.rule: Two quarterback passing-yard prop decisions from different weeks are paired. A combination hits when both legs hit.
prop_combination.dependence_note: The difference between the observed joint hit rate and the average of the two marginal hit rates. Positive means the legs move together.

parlay.name: Two-leg game parlay: the model's side in the two games of a week with the biggest disagreement
parlay.rule: Within each week, take the games where the model's spread differs from the market's by at least 2.0 points and pair the first two. A parlay hits when both legs hit.
parlay.price_note: No parlay price exists in scope, so the parlay can be graded but not staked.

same_game_parlay_dependence.name: Home margin vs game total (same game, parlay legs)
same_game_parlay_dependence.note: A parlay priced as if its legs were independent is mispriced whenever this dependence is not zero. The joint rate and n are published above so the correction can be read rather than assumed.

transcription_check.method: Every game row was transcribed from the official player log table, then the per-player column sums were compared with the official 2026 season totals published on the same page. A mistyped number breaks the sum.
